integrity: Stand-alone exact finite checker is included and its output recorded. Infinite classification is proved separately. The work does not claim independent certification or external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only ternary relational multiplication, equality and a named identity; only rank two; direct computations on A_3 through A_9 and cycle partitions through n=40, with infinite scope relying on the mathematical permutation argument. No claim to uniqueness against unavailable or unindexed prior literature; no independent proof audit.
title: Nine rank-two theories of the finite alternating groups and a persistent parity oscillation
